penal_theft.rationale: Add 263 (theft committed during fire/explosion etc., 10 years) and 264 ("tous autres vols", 5 years): both are theft penalties in the corpus, and 264 is the single most frequent 'wrong' result in the v1 baseline.

penal_homicide.rationale: Add 204 (homicide preceded/accompanied by another offence: death) and 205 (meurtre in all cases not provided above: life imprisonment): they define/penalise murder directly. 201-203 unchanged.

penal_corruption.rationale: Remove 86: its heading says 'Abrogé par la loi n° 1998-33' (empty article). Add 83 (fonctionnaire who agrees to offers/promises, i.e. passive corruption) and 91 (person who corrupted or attempted to corrupt, 5 years). 84-85 unchanged.

penal_fraud.rationale: Add 292: 'assimilé à l'escroquerie et puni des peines prévues à l'article précédent'. 291 is anchored to the main article (two fragment chunks also carry number 291).

proposed_gold.anchor: Article 291 (Modifié par le décret du 8 octobre 1935)

penal_breach_of_trust.rationale: No change; only anchored to the real heading (297 is the abus de confiance article).

penal_defamation.rationale: Add 247: it is the penalty article ('Est puni de six mois d'emprisonnement ... diffamation'); 245 defines diffamation, 246 defines calomnie. 247 is a frequent 'wrong' result in v1 because it is in fact relevant.

penal_rape.rationale: No change in articles; anchors separate 227 and 227 bis (same law, both about rape / sexual acts without violence).

penal_harassment.rationale: Narrow: the harassment article is 226 ter ('commet le harcèlement sexuel', 1 year + 3000 dinars). 226 (outrage public à la pudeur) and 226 bis (atteinte aux bonnes moeurs) are different offences. Keep 226 quater (rules attached to the two preceding articles).

penal_self_defence.rationale: Replace 39 by 40. Art 40 covers 'se défendant contre les auteurs de vols ou de pillages' and repelling a nocturnal break-in = légitime défense. Art 39 is contrainte/état de nécessité ('danger imminent'). JUDGMENT CALL: you may prefer to keep 39 as a related article.

penal_arson.rationale: Remove 309: it punishes fires caused by 'maladresse, imprudence, négligence' (involuntary), while the question asks about incendie volontaire. 307 and 308 unchanged.

penal_assault.rationale: Remove 217: it is homicide involontaire (maladresse, imprudence). Add 208 (coups portés ou blessures faites volontairement sans intention de donner la mort: 20 years). 218-219 unchanged; 218 anchored to the main article (a fragment chunk also carries 218).

const_fundamental_rights.rationale: Add 22 ('L'Etat garantit aux citoyens ... les libertés et les droits individuels et collectifs'). The question is inherently broad; consider whether it should stay in the scored set. NOTE: the chunk labelled 26 also contains Art. 27 ('Art . 27' with a space escapes the splitter).
